n_plus_1_query.instructions: Are database queries batched or fetched together rather than executing separate queries inside a loop for each item (N+1 query)?

hardcoded_secrets.instructions: Are sensitive credentials (API keys, passwords, tokens) loaded from configuration or environment variables rather than hardcoded in source code?

improper_error_handling.instructions: Are exceptions handled safely with clean error responses rather than exposing sensitive internal details or raw stack traces?

sync_blocking_io.instructions: Do async functions perform file and network I/O asynchronously (or offload blocking calls via asyncio.to_thread) rather than blocking the event loop synchronously?

missing_input_validation.instructions: Is external user input properly validated, sanitized, or parameterized rather than used directly in queries or operations?

tight_coupling.instructions: Are external services and third-party APIs integrated behind abstraction layers or interfaces rather than tightly coupled directly inside business logic?

over_fetching_data.instructions: Do database queries select only the specific columns needed rather than over-fetching entire rows (e.g. SELECT *)?
